messages.content: you still at work or home already
just walked in like 10 mins ago
same, traffic on 5th was stupid
oh yeah they're doing construction again?
yeah by the bank, took forever
I just threw laundry in, what's up
was thinking we should grab pizza after work Friday
oh that sounds good actually
like Luigi's on 5th Street?
yes I've been craving their garlic knots
lol same, 6 pm work?
yeah that works for me
perfect, we can beat the dinner rush a little
did you end up finishing that report today
ugh almost, still have like one chart to fix
I hate when it's just one dumb thing left
right? my boss kept pinging me about it too
mine asked me to cover Saturday morning, I said no
good for you, you work too many weekends
seriously, I need an actual weekend
so Friday pizza will be like a kickoff
exactly, no cooking for me that night
you want to just meet there or carpool?
meet there is easier, I'll be coming from office
same, I can park in back like last time
oh did your mom ever call back about Sunday?
yeah we're doing lunch at hers, you're invited btw
oh nice, tell her I said thanks, I might come
she makes that potato salad you like
okay now I definitely have to come lol
lol I told her you'd say that
wait did you see the game last night
only the highlights, that ending was wild
I screamed so loud the cat ran off
hahaha poor cat
she forgave me with treats
so Friday 6 still good? I have to leave work a little early
yep, I'll head straight there after I clock out
cool, I'll grab us a table if I get there first
sounds good, I'll text when I'm parking
btw did you pay the electric bill? I forgot last month
yeah I did autopay finally, so tired of late fees
smart, I should do that too
it took like 5 mins online
I'll do it tomorrow on lunch
okay, pizza Friday then
yep, can't wait honestly
me too, been too long since Luigi's
for real, like a month?
at least, see you at 6
see ya
night!
